products.name: 3DMakerpro Seal 3D Scanner, blue light, 0.01 mm accuracy, 24-bit color (Standard)
specs: JMStudio for Windows 10/11 and macOS 12/13; phone scanning needs the Smart Grip
Intel Core i5 8th gen, 16 GB RAM, 2 GB GPU
Scanner, 65 W PD charger, data cable
products.warranty: 1-year limited warranty from purchase per the Seal user manual; 3DMakerpro lists lifetime software support.
products.returns: Refunds only for defects or items not as described, requested within 7 days of delivery; buyer pays return shipping unless the error is 3DMakerpro's; the store policy excludes sale-priced items from refunds.
products.summary: Blue-light handheld scanner for parts and figures from about 10 mm to 300 mm. Maker-rated 0.01 mm accuracy and 0.05 mm resolution; 3D Printing Industry measured 0.02 mm on a reference block. Captures 24-bit color, tracks without markers, and runs on Windows or Mac.
products.fit: Hobbyists and small-shop users scanning small mechanical parts, figurines, knobs, brackets and other objects that fit in two hands, for 3D printing or CAD reference.
caveats: Shiny, black and metallic parts need matte scanning spray, which then has to be washed off.
Tracking can drop on smooth, symmetrical or featureless parts; add surface features or use the optional turntable.
JMStudio has a learning curve and has crashed on low-spec PCs; meshes are dense and usually need cleanup before printing.
Standard package ships with no tripod or turntable; the maker's multi-axis turntable is a separate purchase.
3DMakerpro's own store has recent reviews complaining about slow shipping and support; retailers such as MatterHackers and Best Buy also stock it.

products.name: 3DMakerpro Seal Lite 3D Scanner, blue light, 0.02 mm accuracy, mono (Standard)
specs: Intel Core i5 8th gen, 16 GB RAM, 2 GB GPU
Scanner, 65 W PD charger, data cable
products.warranty: 1-year limited warranty from purchase per the Seal series user manual; lifetime software support.
products.returns: Refunds only for defects or items not as described, requested within 7 days of delivery; buyer pays return shipping unless the error is 3DMakerpro's; sale-priced items are excluded per the store policy.
products.summary: The plastic-bodied, mono version of the Seal: same blue light, 10 mm minimum object and capture window, with 0.07 mm resolution instead of 0.05 mm and no color texture. The cheapest scanner that still handles parts under 150 mm.
products.fit: Budget buyers who need the shape of small parts for 3D printing and do not need color.
caveats: 0.07 mm resolution softens fine detail such as faces and chainmail on 28 mm miniatures.
Same spray and tracking limits as the Seal on shiny, dark or featureless parts.
A 2-star B&H owner review titled it a disappointment; exact complaints could not be read.

products.name: 3DMakerpro Mole 3D Scanner, near-infrared, 0.05 mm accuracy (Standard)
specs: JMStudio for Windows and macOS; dedicated phone app
products.warranty: 12 months, listed by name in 3DMakerpro's store policy; lifetime software support.
products.returns: Refunds only for defects or items not as described, requested within 7 days of delivery; buyer pays return shipping unless the error is 3DMakerpro's; sale-priced items are excluded per the store policy.
products.summary: 3DMakerpro's older medium-format scanner, now its cheapest. Near-infrared light and a 200 × 100 mm capture window suit shoe-sized objects and faces more than tiny parts.
products.fit: First scanner for busts, shoes, helmets and objects over about 30 mm, on a tight budget.
caveats: 0.1 mm resolution and a wide capture window lose detail on parts under about 30 mm; reviewers found alignment struggles on thin objects.
No hole-filling to speak of in early reviews; expect manual mesh repair.
JMStudio crashed on lower-end machines in one review.

products.name: Revopoint MINI 2 3D Scanner, blue light, 0.02 mm precision (Standard Edition)
specs: Revo Scan 5 for Windows, macOS, iOS and Android
Revopoint recommends a recent Core i7 with 16 GB RAM for fusion
products.warranty: Revopoint lists a 1-year warranty on its scanners; confirm on the product page before buying.
products.returns: Per Revopoint's store policy; not verified today.
products.summary: The small-object specialist. Its 0.02 mm point spacing resolves facial features and chainmail on 28 mm miniatures that 0.05 to 0.07 mm scanners blur.
products.fit: Tabletop miniature makers, jewelers and anyone scanning things under about 30 mm who can afford twice the Seal's price.
caveats: Dark or glossy figures still need scanning spray.
3DSourced reported alignment issues and weak color capture out of the box.
Needs a strong Windows PC for fusion; older laptops stall.
